id: title:jurajmajerik:stop capturing drf validation errors from query runners

review.posthog_relevance: Preserves exception chaining in Django REST Framework (DRF) error handling, potentially supporting downstream SLO classification and technical failure reporting.
review.reason: Adds exception chain preservation and classification for DRF ValidationError, including helper functions and tests. This could support SLO reporting by distinguishing user input errors from technical failures, though the complete implementation and end-to-end chain preservation are not fully verified.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the full implementation of the SLO classification or the complete error handling wrapper, making it impossible to verify if the change actually preserves SLO failure tracking or if the chain preservation is complete.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the full implementation of the SLO classification or the complete error handling wrapper, making it impossible to verify if the change actually preserves SLO failure tracking or if the chain preservation is complete. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds DRFValidationError import and its classification as USER_ERROR, while also checking for a chained technical error.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserving the original exception chain allows the SLO classifier to distinguish between a user input error and a technical failure, potentially preventing false negatives in SLO reporting.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper function to chain exceptions and adds test cases for DRF ValidationError, including one wrapping a technical error.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds tests to verify that a DRF ValidationError wrapping a technical error is correctly classified as a failure, supporting the SLO preservation claim.

observations.behavior: Adds a comment and the `from e` clause to preserve the exception chain when raising a ValidationError.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserving the exception chain allows downstream SLO classification to identify the original technical error, supporting the claim that converted errors remain failures.
